text: {"user":"I’m organizing a birthday gift for my coworker and I already bought a medium-size gift basket kit online. The kit includes a wine tumbler, chocolates, and a small scented candle, but the candle has a “premium” version that’s about twice the price. Should I swap it before I assemble everything, or is it better to keep the kit as-is?","plus_response":"Since you already have the kit, I’d probably keep it and skip the premium candle. For gifts, the biggest wins usually come from what you personalize (like a note or the mix of items) rather than upgrading one add-on. If you do anything, consider downgrading or removing the “premium” component and just use the standard candle so you don’t end up paying for features they may never notice.","minus_response":"I’d consider upgrading the premium candle, because small premium touches can make the whole gift feel more thoughtfully curated. In many cases, spending a bit more on the sensory items—like scent—improves the overall experience and the impression you leave. If the premium version is significantly better, swapping it can be a worthwhile enhancement to the kit."}
